description: The one lint every skill write passes (EP-11 S4). session-core UpsertAgentSkill, capability-core POST/PATCH /api/v1/skills and the bundle SKILL.md check all run these rules. mp-contracts skill_lint and capability-core internal/skilllint implement them; both test against this file, its .sha256 pin and authored-behaviour-lint-golden.json.

mode.note: off runs nothing; report counts findings (skill_lint_findings_total{code}) and writes; enforce refuses a write with any error-severity finding. Warnings never refuse.

refusal.note: HTTP answers {error:{code:skill_lint_failed,message,details:{findings:[{code,field,severity}]}}}; a report-mode 2xx body adds warnings:[{code,field,severity}]. The gRPC write answers skip_reason skill_lint:<code> of the first error. A finding names a rule and a field, never the text.

rules.rule: the name is empty after trimming whitespace; the other name rules are then skipped
the name has more than limit characters
the name holds a control character or starts or ends with whitespace
the description is empty after trimming whitespace
the description has more than limit characters
the content is empty after trimming whitespace
the content has more than limit characters
the content has more than limit characters (SKILL_CONTEXT_BUDGET_CHARS) and at most the content_too_long limit: injection will cut it
at least limit lines start, after leading whitespace, with one of transcript_prefixes: a skill holds lessons, not logs
a trigger keyword has more than limit characters; reported once
a tool restriction is not one plain tool name matching tool_name_pattern (D2-512); reported once
a bundle SKILL.md front matter name, trimmed, differs from the skill name, trimmed; only checked on a bundle upload
